notes: Pure 2025 public-API evidence for one Clause 7 object-class element-value conflict. Two adapter-owned, schema-valid FOM modules contain same-named object-class declarations that differ only in class semantics. The portable C++ and Java cases require InconsistentFOM from Create Federation Execution and prove a valid retry can reuse the federation name and expose the class to a member. The internal and public native cases passed, and installed-package C++ CTest/direct runs passed in both callback models; an explicit adapter-FOM override also passed. Java compiled against the API-only JAR and focused packaged-provider runtime passed in both callback models (out/java-tck/object-class-semantics-conflict-*-20261021.json). Other class fields, Annex C.3 data-type rules, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
